messages:
sam: flagging this thread after morning alarms ~04:32 UTC. cross-region egress from us-east to eu-west showed increased TLS handshake failures and a spike in client retries. posting quick triage notes and owners.
olivia: saw ~2.8% retry rate for 9m. timeline aligns with a control-plane route reconcile at 04:28. logs show `certificate mismatch` and `unexpected_message` on some edges.
hiro: grabbed cert metadata from an affected node; cert CN matches legacy-edge.local for a small subset of nodes. looks like a route map pointed a slice of traffic to an old pool.
mike: mitigations executed at 04:40: pinned cross-region egress to the stable pool, drained suspected legacy nodes, and issued a config reload. metrics returned to baseline by 04:55.
sam: triage action items (owner / ETA):
  - mike -> remove legacy pool entries from global routing map and add deny rule (ETA 2026-04-03)
  - olivia -> add post-rollout SNI+cert verification probe into the control-plane job (ETA 2026-03-30)
  - hiro -> add an SNI-thumbprint mismatch metric and alert (ETA 2026-03-28)
  - sam -> update runbook with pin/drain/reload checklist + smoke commands (ETA 2026-03-26)
ops-bot: created tracking ticket RH-4230 and assigned to mike,olivia,hiro,sam.
mike: splitting RH-4230: RH-4230a (routing cleanup), RH-4230b (control-plane probe), RH-4230c (runbook updates). will link PRs.
olivia: long-term mitigations proposed: route-change suppression window, canary TLS probes, and client SDK jitter to reduce amplification.
sam: scheduling a 20m sync Fri to review PRs and split ownership. please prefix updates with "RH-4230" so ops-bot threads them.
ops-bot: RH-4230 status=open; next_check=2026-03-27T09:00:00Z.
